title: Equinor says it is dealing with a cyberattack on its IT systems
date_note: Equinor first disclosed the attack on Tuesday evening (17 November), per The Register's 19 November article.
summary: The Register reports Equinor disclosed a cyberattack on its IT systems on Tuesday evening. On Thursday the company said the attack was ongoing but did not appear to target it specifically, and that production continued normally. The Register says Equinor has not identified those responsible or said when affected systems will be fully restored.
plain: Norwegian energy company Equinor says it is dealing with a cyberattack on its IT systems; production is reported to continue normally.
exec: A cyberattack on a major energy company's IT systems, with no stated recovery date, can disrupt corporate operations.

validation.note: Only The Register read; it relays Equinor statements, NTB and Reuters. Equinor's own statement not read.
